clarification_questions.question: Is the result intended for research, a pilot line or production?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan (Research or development: plan: a screening-level plan is enough; Pilot or trial line: plan: validation at pilot scale; Production, monitoring or batch release: plan: stricter validation plan)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: The intended use sets how strict the validation plan has to be.

clarification_questions.question: Do you have a reference method that provides comparison values for API concentration?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan (Yes, a laboratory method: plan: calibrate against it and state its own error; No, none yet: plan: a reference measurement campaign comes first)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: Models can only be as good as the reference values they are built on.

clarification_questions.question: Do you already have numerical acceptance criteria, such as required accuracy or a detection limit?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan (Yes, they are defined: plan: test against the agreed criteria; Not yet: plan: agree numerical criteria before the test)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: Without them the experiment has no go or no-go criterion.

clarification_questions.question: Over what range must API concentration be followed?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan (Narrow, around a set point: plan: sample around the set point; Wide, from low to high: plan: sample the full range)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: The range decides whether the sensitivity of a method can be enough.

clarification_questions.question: How quickly must an API concentration result be available?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan (Real time, within seconds: plan: a short link and fast sampling; Hours are fine: plan: at-line sampling may be enough)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: The response time limits the measurement and sampling set-up.

clarification_questions.question: Where can the probe be installed at the tablet press feed frame?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: Access and cleaning decide the probe geometry and the maintenance effort.

setup.text: Collect NIR diffuse-reflection and Raman spectra at the agreed measurement point, ensuring same-spot, time-aligned sampling for any combined measurements.

comparison.text: Compare the unchanged existing calibration with separately developed new-formulation NIR and Raman models before testing a combined model with dedicated data-fusion processing.

validation.text: Validate each candidate on independent new-formulation material excluded from model fitting and selection.

go_no_go.text: Base go/no-go on acceptance criteria agreed with the client before testing.
